// What We Do

OUR SERVICES

Every service performed on-location — your home, office, wherever. No drop-offs. Ever.

🚗
Full Detail

Our most popular service — a complete inside and out transformation. Exterior hand wash, clay bar, wax, full interior deep clean, steam, windows, doors, dash, and trim. Your car leaves looking showroom fresh.

Most Popular
🪣
Interior Detailing

Deep vacuum, shampoo, surface wipe-down, leather & vinyl conditioning, windows, and odor treatment. Your cabin, brand new.

✨
Exterior Detailing

Hand wash, clay bar decontamination, polish, and wax or sealant to restore that deep factory-fresh gloss.

🔵
Ceramic Coating

Nano-ceramic protection bonded directly to your paint. Repels water, UV, and grime for years — not weeks.

Premium
🎨
Paint Correction

Multi-stage compounding removes swirl marks, light scratches, oxidation, and water spots. Paint restored to showroom.

Premium
💡
Headlight Restoration

Foggy, yellowed headlights reduce visibility by up to 80%. We restore them to crystal-clear condition with UV sealant to protect results for 1–2 years.

High-Value Add-On
💧
Steam & Stain Extraction

Hot water extraction and steam treatment destroys stubborn stains, bacteria, and pet hair from carpet and upholstery.

// Our Story

DETAILING THAT
MAKES A DIFFERENCE.

Run 'N Tail That Detailing LLC was built on a simple belief — your car deserves professional care, and you deserve the convenience of having it come to you.

Based in Winston-Salem, NC, we're a mobile detailing team that shows up equipped, on time, and ready to work. No shop drop-offs. No waiting rooms. Just showroom-quality results delivered to your driveway, office parking lot, or wherever your car lives.

We work on everything — daily drivers, luxury vehicles, family SUVs, trucks, and more. Whether it's a quick exterior refresh or a full paint correction with ceramic coating, we treat every vehicle like it's our own.

Same-day and next-day appointments available. Serving Winston-Salem and communities across North Carolina, 7 days a week.

// Common Questions

FREQUENTLY ASKED
QUESTIONS

Do I need to be home during the detail?
Nope! As long as we have access to your vehicle, you don't need to be present. Many customers leave their car and come back to a clean ride.
Do you bring your own water and power?
Yes — we're fully self-contained. We bring everything we need including water, power, and all professional equipment. No hookups required from you.
How long does a detail take?
A basic exterior wash takes 45–60 minutes. A full interior + exterior detail typically takes 1.5–2.5 hours depending on vehicle size and condition.
Do you offer same-day appointments?
Yes! Same-day and next-day appointments are available based on our schedule. Call or book online and we'll get you in as fast as possible.
What vehicles do you detail?
Cars, trucks, SUVs, vans, trailers, and more. We work on everything from daily drivers to luxury vehicles. No vehicle is too big or too dirty.
What areas do you serve?
We're based in Winston-Salem and serve Clemmons, Kernersville, High Point, Greensboro, Burlington, Reidsville, Siler City, Chapel Hill, Durham, and surrounding areas within 50 miles.
How does pricing work?
Pricing is based on vehicle size and service selected. Basic wash starts at $50, interior detail from $100, full detail from $150. All prices are starting rates — we'll give you an exact quote before we start.
Is there a referral program?
Yes! Refer 3 friends and get a FREE Full Detail. Plus, mention our promo when booking to receive 10% off your next service. We appreciate every referral.
